data.desc: Founded in 2017, LifeStance (Nasdaq: LFST) is reimagining mental health. We are one of the nation's largest providers of virtual and in-person outpatient mental healthcare for children, adolescents and adults experiencing a variety of mental health conditions. Our mission is to help people lead healthier, more fulfilling lives by improving access to trusted, affordable, and personalized mental healthcare. LifeStance and its supported practices employ over 8,800 psychiatrists, advanced practice nurses, psychologists and therapists and operates across 35 states and more than 575 centers. To learn more, please visit www.LifeStance.com.
